title: Ghost Reaper Girl
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Chloé, a 28-year-old actress stuck in B-horror films, has an 'occult body type' that attracts spirits; with the help of the mysterious Kai she transforms into the ghostbuster Ghost Reaper Girl to stop evil spirits escaping from the underworld (MANGA Plus and Viz blurbs via AniList and MangaUpdates; But Why Tho? review). It is a Shonen Jump+ webcomic from the creator of Rosario+Vampire.
life_message: Chasing a dream while fighting off those who would use you takes grit.

content.note: Exorcisms, possession and Chloé's 'spontaneous displays of violence' (But Why Tho?); Possession, Exorcism (MangaUpdates).
Ghost designs called 'gorgeously weird' (review); comedic tone.
Opens with an attempted sexual assault; constant sexual innuendo and threat of assault (But Why Tho?); Ecchi genre, Sexual Harassment, Perverted Male Lead (MangaUpdates).
